title: TasteJump
description:
How high can you get?

TasteJump is a 3D climbing platformer across five distinct height zones — from dense jungle to icy peaks — wrapped in permanent, magical moonlight. Every jump counts, every misstep sends you back down.

Four modes, one goal: higher.

Classic — climb at your own pace, no pressure

Time Attack — race the clock with a live timer and zone splits

Hardcore — one mistake and you start over

Endless — the tower never stops growing

Collect, unlock, style yourself.

Earn coins as you climb and spend them in the shop on skins and cosmetics

25 achievements, real leaderboards.

From your first zone to a perfect no-death run — there's something to chase no matter how you play. Local, signed top-10 leaderboard per mode.
